notes.title: NEWS #2 - 16 BIT NIGHTS
notes.content:
Hello players,


We have some important news regarding our [b]16 BIT NIGHTS[/b] company's future.


[h1]01 Welcome Back, Commander[/h1]
The game has been released. We also provided a series of updates after release, and the game is now rock solid with a very positive rating.
Unfortunately, the actual sales were under our expectations, and my partner and I had a lot of arguing regarding this, so we decided to [i]"part ways,"[/i] which brings me to the next point.
You can check out the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3015620/Welcome_Back_Commander/


[h1]02 NEW GAME #1[/h1]
My partner will work on a new game without me. He will use the artwork I made for previous Chromosome Evil/Welcome Back Commander games, and he will also use the [b]16 BIT NIGHTS[/b] branding for publishing, so even though we parted ways, we are still working together to some extent.
He plans on experimenting with co-op multiplayer within an extraction squad-based type of gameplay.
More details soon.


[h1]03 NEW GAME #2[/h1]
I will also work on a game, but I don't want to give out spoilers yet other than it will be a new IP with unique squad-based gameplay.
I will also be working on this one with a new partner.
In addition, this year, I will also try to focus more on our YouTube channel and make full playthroughs of our games with commentary.


[h1]04 NEW GAME #3[/h1]
In collaboration with [b]Real Heroes Studio[/b], we would like to announce a big demo update on [b]Desolated District[/b] on 27 April.
This is a fresh take for us since it's our first project as a collaborative effort with another developer studio. We have a minimal involvement rezumed to environment storytelling design, graffiti sprites, polish interface stage, design consultations, and marketing consultation.
The game is a 3D survival crafting with a nice magical touch within a Kowloon Walled City theme.
You can Wishlist it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2454070/Desolated_District/


[h1]05 Lovecraftian Days Fest[/h1]
We would also like to announce that the  [b]Lovecraftian Days [/b]steam festival hosted by Fulqrum publisher has started, and [b]Welcome Back, Commander[/b], along with [b]Chromosome Evil[/b] and [b]Chromosome Evil 2,[/b] are participating.
To celebrate this, we put together a new trailer that highlights some of the Lovecraftian-inspired bosses you can encounter in Welcome Back, Commander.
Trailer link: https://youtu.be/1HYEjJh_0eU
Link to event: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/lovecraftiandays2025


[h1]06 16 BIT NIGHTS bundle[/h1]
For our hardcore fans who would like to support us in the future, we also updated our 16 BIT NIGHTS bundle with a discount on ALL our games:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29954/16_BIT_NIGHTS/


07 16 BIT NIGHTS Steam developer Page.
We have also established a Steam Developer Page for those of you who want to be notified of all our future official releases.
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/16bitnights







Regards,
Cristi P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: NEWS - 16 BIT NIGHTS
notes.content:
Hi,

We have BIG news and a call to action.


Let's start.


[h1]1. Main Project "Welcome Back, Commander"[/h1]

Well it happened, we remained out of funding at the beginning of this November but after serious consideration, we decided to push forward by using our personal economies which should allow us to extend development time until the middle of Q1 2025.

"Welcome Back, Commander" is set to have 2-3 hours of playthrough but high replay value and high production value. 

We are still in discussion on what the price will be but as a general idea, the game will cost a minimum 5$ - a maximum of 10$. 

[b]We also need to decide what secondary monetization to have, some possibilities are still on the table, maybe you players can help us out with a vote?[/b]

[h1]A.[/h1] we release the game for 5$ and if we get enough attention on the game we we will keep updating the main game version but increase the price gradually up to 20$ to cover development costs.
[h1]B. [/h1]we release the game for 5$ and we also add one supporter DLC for 30$, it will have MINIMAL cosmetic content but it will be 100% optional as in just for the people who enjoyed our games to support us and if enough support on this DLC then we will keep pushing free content on the main game.
[h1]C. [/h1]we release the game for 5$ and we add 3 content DLCs(extra maps, extra endings and other content) for 10$ each DLC.

[h2]CALL TO ACTION[/h2]

Meantime if you want to support us, smash that wishlist button like u love it:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3015620/Welcome_Back_Commander/

We hope to have it released in Q1 of 2025.




[h1]2. Collaboration with "Real Heroes Studio"[/h1]

So, a couple of weeks ago we met the solo dev from "Real Heroes Studio", he had a game called "Desolated District" in which we saw potential, and after some ideas exchange, we decided to help him out in his endeavors.

This will be an experimental collaboration for "16 Bit Nights". 
We will contribute to "Real Heroes Studio" with Marketing consultancy, environmental storytelling design, and some other minor investments.

If the experiment will turn out to have a positive outcome then we will consider investing in other small indie developers in the future.

[h2]CALL TO ACTION[/h2]

You can smash that wishlist button and find this magical open-world-survival-crafting game on Steam here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2454070/Desolated_District/ 

We hope to have it released in Q2 of 2025.







[h1]3. Overall situation[/h1]

2025 will be a very risky year for us and we need all the support we can get.

If you want to support us, smash the wishlist buttons for "Welcome Back, Commander" and "Desolated District", smash it like you mean it!





Regards,
Cristi P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: NEW GAME annoucement
notes.content:
Hey folks,

We just released a coming soon page for our next creation and we need you to SMAH that wishlist button.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3015620/Welcome_Back_Commander/

"Welcome Back, Commander" is the final entry from the Chromosome Evil Franchise and Trilogy, and its a prequel.

What type of game will it be?
Well, our funds will end this winter so we thought very carefully about the direction we will be going. 
Welcome Back Commander - will remove some of the complexity and will only take the essence of the Chromosome Evil franchise.
We aim for a lot shorter gameplay time but with very high-reliability potential. Something that can provide a sweet capsule of fun on any rainy day.

Also, did we mention that the teaser has 5 minutes? :))
It was a big collaborative effort with people from different communities who donated voice-acting and support so we really hope you will enjoy it because it reflects the mood of this new game: Atmospheric value + 90thies action movie feels.

notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/473aba5f241ed14640bf547425e93e09e28c262f.gif[/img]

[b]
UPDATE TIME
Bow&arrows are back[/b]


Good news, we managed to push one more big update for you!

A major update. Version 1.5x
. For those who have played recently:
1 Added a new bow weapon. At first, it is not strong, but it does not waste bullets, but consumes materials.
2 Improved ammo has been added:
-Enhanced. It just increases the hit damage.
Incendiary. If hit, there will be a chance to set fire to the target. Arrows are set on fire immediately. The target is constantly taking damage and will not live long.
Poisoned. If hit, there will be a chance to poison the target. Arrows infect immediately. The target slows down, weakens, and takes damage.
Explosive. Radically increase the damage. But we need to get to them...
-Weighted arrows throw off enemies.
3 Improved the burning and poisoning of enemies. Changed mechanics and damage. Also now they continue to burn and die even after losing their legs.
4 Everything except car repairs and mining can now be done on the go on the global map.


[b]New enhanced ammunition types[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/472632ef8ad21a0e6c61b2719f984b80dfeb0f8d.png[/img]

For those who played around the release:
1 At least 3 times there was a serious revision of the balance of the game. The complexity has increased, global effects have been added, and mechanics that did not work well at first have been debugged.
2 Added story missions during evolutionary jumps. The evolution system has also been revised. Enemies now have weapons after clear stages.
3 The cards for the grind have been replenished.
4 A lot of management changes. Fighters are now much more responsive, less sticky when managing allocation. The change of equipment in the inventory has been greatly reduced.
5 Heavy mode is now really heavy.
For those who haven't played yet:
If you were in doubt whether to take the game or not, now is the time to play a demo version and see that the game has become much more enjoyable to manage.lp of feedback from the players, we managed to improve the gameplay, bring the balance to a pleasant level, and introduce several mechanics that made the game even more interesting. Now you will be able to see not a raw game, but one that is quite worthy of your attention. Since the release, many bugs have been fixed and many edits have been made to make it better. The game is not dead, but continues to improve and I am always open to suggestions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/4c87fb64b241d81be4b4ac608fa8947de468a0da.png[/img]

Want to support us?
 Join our Discord:
https://discord.gg/USFbBSBeTZ



regards,
Cristi P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: BIG UPDATE + news of our current situation.
notes.content:
Hey Players,

It's been 2 weeks since we released the game so now it's time to share some of the data behind the curtain, a summary, and a big update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/838bcc36757727d83f1c905d6f0a0d85ac93cf13.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/51f9b3b1af5df4a20f434d2c55a920f321c1b90e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/061dc48d57415ea084e4acb1ec0f0a4a3a70329a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/a68c264b7a7e23c683ca50b9aa91f2daa972f1fa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/d662af5cee1dd56b35c600ef4eaaf06ea332aae1.png[/img]

First good news, Chromosome Evil 2 got approved for trading cards, we just uploaded the trading cards artwork and we are waiting for final confirmation, I estimate they should be dropping by the end of next week.



[b]Summary since the release:[/b]

- bug fixing, my partner had a marathon in fixing bugs, it's hard to track but overall he made fixes each day since the release, and we must add here an addition Thank you players for having patience with us
- minor balance adjustments
- minor quality of life features

[b]Today's BIG Update[/b]

- Re-balance, today a huge re-balance of the game took place, mele was to OP and the game lacked that dangerous element, we noticed in many videos that people would just grind everything, well no more, now you will need real survival skills
- New content, we added 5 evolution event scenarios(chapter 3) that will get triggered on certain evolution stages to spice up the survival experience.


WARNING: because we added a lot in this new update there might be some new bugs, if you encounter them please report them, and my partner will fix them.




[b]Our current situation[/b]

Well unfortunately here the situation is not very good for us.
We failed to reach any of our major milestones in matter of sales and Steam engagement.

This was due to a number of factors, fortunately, the game quality is not one of them.

Right now we are on the floating line and we must consider our next move very carefully.
We probably have funding left to keep making games until the coming winter, so if any Game of Thrones fans around here know that for us the"winter is coming" expression is BRUTAL.



[b]The future[/b]

We have read all the reviews and noticed that the people who played it liked our creation a lot, which brought joy to our hearts.
So, right now we are going to fix all bugs that get reported including balance adjustments.
And if the game will get serious attention from the player community in the future we will also consider adding more extra content to it.



Thank you, players!









Regards
Cristi P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: Chromosome Evil 2 - RELEASED
notes.content:
[b]ITS OUT![/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/ff9019dc6cb8a7fe45277ad37bce995c8b062dee.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/ff9019dc6cb8a7fe45277ad37bce995c8b062dee.gif[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/85a125fc8e38f15eef891516d4fc74e6cba3c78c.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/85a125fc8e38f15eef891516d4fc74e6cba3c78c.gif[/img][/url]


[b]What have we prepared for you?[/b]
A heavy tactical survival adventure set in a Lovecraftian horror theme and mixed with heavy management.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/8d8af28e8ad459959f59f81dfde3370fffa3c406.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/8d8af28e8ad459959f59f81dfde3370fffa3c406.gif[/img][/url]

[b]What's next?[/b]
Well, the first thing is that during the first 2 weeks after the release we are going to do maintenance, meaning we are going to adjust things and kill all the reported bugs(if any) because a good bug is a dead bug.
We strongly recommend that you use either Steam Bug report main topic or our Discord Bug report room, please do not create new topics for bug reports.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/20aea7426a4b198a584c4a4c13593fd2a0dc56c9.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/20aea7426a4b198a584c4a4c13593fd2a0dc56c9.gif[/img][/url]

Then we need to decide on the future road map for future extra content and DLCs, this will be based on how many support milestones we get from you in the first 2 weeks after release because surely if you don't like the game there will be no point in adding more content.
If you want to know the exact details of what we consider a milestone you can join our discord to find out.



[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/d31dc9b26e44db31eb92f38afb4f98ba9bf7e148.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/d31dc9b26e44db31eb92f38afb4f98ba9bf7e148.gif[/img][/url]



[b]How was the Early Acces for us?[/b]
Well, we were barely on the floating line, we have chosen to move forward without a publisher in order to have total freedom in our creativity and legal bindings.
But on the bright side, we managed to reach all goals from EA meaning all planned content was successfully implemented, so no broken promises, HURAY!
We haven't had an EA game in a long time so this was a fresh experience for us.









This being said we really hope you enjoyed the game and if you think we are on the right path please do let us know.






Best Regards,
Cristi P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.title: News on the FInal Chapter and some Q&A
notes.content:
Hey Players,


Are you ready to cross the bridge in the final chapter of Chromosome Evil 2? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/d7b6acdf5d067f624f8e5806a44638e9eda43b60.gif[/img]


[u]We start this by saying Thank you, players, thank you for the constant support![/u]


So let us begin with the Q&A session.


[b]Do you plan on adding more things to the game besides Chapter 4?[/b]
Yes, we plan on adding 3 main quest scenarios for Chapter 3 that will make the connection for Chapter 4.
We also had 1 guy on our Discord who was obsessed with adding a cat in the game and because he is a long-time supporter, now we have a cat in the game that will appear at random times.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/eb137e12e4de409f2d3e8a6c61cccb7adee89d1c.gif[/img]

[b]What are we working on now?[/b]
Right now we work full-time on the final chapter(4) of the game. 

[b]Can we make our own maps?[/b]
Yes, we released the map editor for free, you can find it in the game folder, and if you make any good maps you can send them to our Discord so that we may add them in the actual game.
Unfortunately, there will be no Steamworks support because for the previous editor, we had Steamworks support, and not many people used it but OFC if we see a serious interest in the editor we will consider adding Steamworks support again.

[b]Any news for the full release?[/b]
Yes, we hope to fully release the game by the end of next month(February), if we encounter any delays we will make an announcement.

[b]What will Chapter 4 have?[/b]
1 unique location with 3 long scenarios and Bosses. There will be 2 of these locations according to the path you will take and yes multiple endings and all that magical stuff.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450829/0cb0ab6c4dda1d138cc2be255599b7bff623844e.gif[/img]

[b]How can we support this project?[/b]
We are small-time indies, a team of only 2 people so any support is appreciated. 
You can support us by following our Twitter and re-tweeting our news, you can also share any news about our game on social media, every bit of help counts.






If you have any additional questions feel free to ask us.

We also invite you all to our Discord for live chat.
Invitation:   [url=https://discord.gg/cqZkRDV7Eb]https://discord.gg/cqZkRDV7Eb[/url]




Best regards,
Cristian P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS

notes.content:

Lots of new things we did in the past 2 weeks.

The most critical was a serious bug that caused random crashes at the start of the game or on load of a game.
Well good news everyone, that critical bug was fixed, unfortunately, it caused a serious drawback with our deadlines but we believe we can still handle it.

We apologize for any problems caused by this critical bug and we want to thank you all for not losing faith in us, there was one guy who despite this critical bug still gave us positive feedback, this truly heartwarming for us and we will do our best not to let you down.

We released in Early access so that means the game is NOT finished and because we constantly push new content and fix bugs new bugs will occur, but rest assured we will fix them all as long as the bugs are reported on the bug report topic or on our discord.
I say this because I noticed some people expected finished clean games in Early access and if that is the case I strongly suggest you stay away from this game until the full release(somewhere in February we hope) and only try it out now if you want to get involved in its development and support the developers.

notes.title: Next Fest and news on release
notes.content:
Hello players,

[b]We would like to announce the start of Steam Next Fest and Chromosome Evil participation.[/b]

The Demo is now available for the public until the end of this festival so feel free to give it a test drive and tell us what you think.

We are also attempting to livestream the game today.





Now the hard part:

[b]Keeping our studio free of publisher control[/b]

We had to make some serious choices in order to keep our studio free of publisher control so the following decisions have been made:


We will release the game in [b]Early Acces in half of November[/b](next month) and we hope for a full release during February - March 2024.

Based on the EA results and reception we hope to be able to keep going forward with self-publishing and out of external publisher control so any support is appreciated.

notes.title: News and Public Demo Release
notes.content:
Hey players,

we are so glad to see many of you again here, and we start the first announcement by saying thank you to everybody who supported us on the first installment of this series! [b]We read all the reviews[/b], you made this sequel possible!


[b]Now on to the main news, we just released the public demo of Chromosome Evil 2 on Steam for a limited period of time. [/b]



And here are some fun facts from behind the scenes:
Fun Fact #1:
Chromosome Evil 1 took 5 years of part-time and Chromosome Evil 2 took 1 year and a half of full-time.
Fun Fact #2:
All art was made in Windows Paint.
Fun Fact #2:
My partner remade again the entire engine mostly for the zoom-in function mechanic.



We still working on the game as we speak and we hope for a release sometime in the coming weeks.
 If you guys have any questions feel free to join our Discord and we will gladly answer them in real time.



Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/BAYezHaMa4]https://discord.gg/BAYezHaMa4[/url] 






Regards,
Cristian P. - 16 BIT NIGHTS
